UniqueEquipmentTraits.Core.Armor.ArmorTr.label: acceleration
UniqueEquipmentTraits.Core.Armor.ArmorTr.description: Integrated into this equipment is an advanced network of kinetic actuators and neural-response enhancers, designed to synchronize the wearer's movements with extraordinary precision. By anticipating muscular impulses and assisting each motion at precisely the right moment, these systems allow a skilled fighter to unleash a relentless succession of strikes with seemingly effortless fluidity. To an untrained observer, the wearer's movements appear almost unnaturally fast, as though the world around them has begun to slow down.
